name: ir_list_supported_companies
description:
The companies the investor relations (ir_*) tools support, from SAJHA's built-in company database.
Returns {total_supported, supported_tickers, companies_with_cik, platforms (count per IR site platform), scrapers: [{ticker, supported, company_name, scraper_class, ir_page_url, ir_platform, has_cik, sec_fallback_available}]}.
Inputs: none.
Use it before the other ir_* tools to confirm a ticker is covered. No network call; no API key.
Example: {}

supported_companies.description: List of all supported companies with IR data

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
useCases: Discover available companies for IR data
Check if a company is supported
Get IR page URLs for supported companies
